rv.q: 'Til Death offers a promising dramatic situation and a couple of stars but fritters away its many opportunities.
You too may long for the sweet relief of death before the 75-minute runtime is over.
They cope individually because they do not know how to cope together, which is incredibly true to life.
Coplan makes a worthy effort to explore this difficult subject, but alas the play falls short of the mark.
The 75-minute play is short on length but long on being tiresome in its exploration of one family's dealings with a matriarch who is dying of cancer.

With such choppy pacing, slipshod writing and distracting scenic design, ’Til Death can’t even coast on the Broadway talent leading the cast, as Kaye and Cuccioli have not been given vibrant, credible personalities to work with. ’Til Death runs through Dec.
